introduction: The UK Ministry of Justice AI Data Quality and Governance Framework establishes a mandatory, auditable, and repeatable standard for managing artificial intelligence initiatives across all executive agencies and arms-length bodies. This framework enforces strict compliance with UK AI regulations, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and relevant EU AI Act principles to ensure that public sector algorithmic systems operate transparently, fairly, and securely. Through structured stage gates, machine-readable data contracts, tiered governance pathways for COTS and Generative AI, automated data profiling, continuous operational telemetry, and robust decommissioning protocols, the framework guarantees full auditability and protects sensitive justice-sector data assets throughout their entire lifecycle.
constraints: Mandatory adherence to statutory UK GDPR, Data Protection Act 2018, and Crown Commercial Service procurement frameworks without exception.

Strict requirement to handle criminal justice, court, and offender records under HMG Government Security Classifications (OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE / SECRET), preventing use of unaccredited public cloud AI models.
Fixed annual MoJ Digital & Technology departmental budgetary allocations and finite availability of cleared AI specialist auditors and data governance personnel.
